title: ACFIX: Guiding LLMs with Mined Common RBAC Practices for Context-Aware Repair of Access Control Vulnerabilities in Smart Contracts
note: Abstract only; mined RBAC role-permission taxonomy (49 pairs from 344K contracts) retrieved and injected via CoT prompt; compared vs GPT-4 baseline (94.92% vs 52.54%), not a representation-isolated ablation.

title: Harnessing the Power of LLMs in Source Code Vulnerability Detection
note: Full text; source converted to LLVM IR then dependency-graph-sliced into iSeVC code gadgets, tokenized and used to finetune BERT/DistilBERT; compared vs VulDeeLocator/LSTM, ablation only varies classifier FC-layer count, not representation.

title: RepoAudit: An Autonomous LLM-Agent for Repository-Level Code Auditing
note: Full text; agent traverses call graph and data-dependence graph via tree-sitter/static-analysis tool calls plus an LLM validator loop; ablation table (w/o abstraction, w/o validator, w/o caching) plus baseline comparison vs Meta Infer/CodeGuru/CoT/LLMDFA, but not a fixed-context-budget representation isolation.

title: SecVulEval: Benchmarking LLMs for Real-World C/C++ Vulnerability Detection
note: Full text; benchmark of 25,440 functions with statement-level labels; a multi-agent (Normalization/Planning/Context/Detection) pipeline extracts interprocedural symbol context via tree-sitter and concatenates it into the detection prompt; benchmarks SOTA LLMs (best F1 23.83%), no clean context-ablation numbers surfaced.

title: LLMxCPG: Context-Aware Vulnerability Detection Through Code Property Graph-Guided Large Language Models
note: Full text; CPG-derived backward slices (67.84-90.93% size reduction) serialized as text into the prompt; Appendix C compares full-code vs sliced input on the same model but context length necessarily differs (confound), and headline results are vs SOTA baselines (+15-40% F1), not a fixed-budget isolation.

title: ParaVul: A Parallel Large Language Model and Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Smart Contract Vulnerability Detection
note: Full text; parallel architecture: an LLM branch finetuned (SLoRA) on raw contract text plus a hybrid dense+BM25 RAG branch retrieving similar vulnerable contracts, fused via a meta-learning model; measured F1 vs baselines (0.94/0.93 single/multi-label), no clean RAG-removed ablation confirmed.

title: VulnLLM-R: Specialized Reasoning LLM with Agent Scaffold for Vulnerability Detection
note: Full text; static call-graph paths seed context and the model (finetuned on agentic trajectories) can invoke a function-retrieval-by-name tool at inference; measured vs CodeQL/AFL++/RepoAudit/commercial models; reported ablations target training-recipe components, not context representation.

title: LLM-based Vulnerability Detection at Project Scale: An Empirical Study
note: Full text; empirical black-box comparison of 5 heterogeneous LLM tools (RepoAudit: agent/call-graph; KNighter: CSA-checker gen; IRIS: CodeQL loop; LLMDFA: agent/dataflow; INFERROI: CFG loop) plus 2 traditional tools on 222 CVEs/24 projects; explicitly not a controlled representation ablation, a cross-tool benchmark.

title: Taint-Style Vulnerability Detection and Confirmation for Node.js Packages Using LLM Agent Reasoning
note: Abstract only (html and ar5iv both 404); explicitly avoids dedicated static/dynamic taint engines, LLM agent reasons over raw package code through a scan-propose-generate PoC-execution-validate pipeline; compared vs prior program-analysis tools (<=22% confirmation) and a prior LLM-hybrid tool (84%), no representation ablation.

title: MemRepair: Hierarchical Memory for Agentic Repository-Level Vulnerability Repair
note: Full text; agent with view/search/Iter_grep(AST-based)/str_replace tools plus a 3-layer memory (History-Fix, Security-Pattern, Refinement-Trajectory) retrieved into prompts; Table 3 ablates memory layers (Loop-only 36% to full 58% on SEC-Bench, vs OpenHands 38.5%), a strong component ablation but per-arm context budget not confirmed fixed.

title: DREA: Decoupled Reasoning and Exploration Agents for Repository-Level Vulnerability Detection
note: Full text; explorer agent (ls/glob/grep/read_file tools) retrieves repo facts synthesized into the planner's hypothesis-update loop; Table 3 ablation (Function-Only 19% / Whole-File 26% / DREA 42% Pair-Correctness) holds the planner LLM fixed but token budget varies sharply (3K/20K/88K), so not a strict fixed-budget isolation despite authors' own framing.
